source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-10

procedures.title: Transmission side cover (Warner 3-speed): remove, overhaul and install
steps: Set that shaft and plate in neutral (middle detent), then fit the interlock sleeve, a ball, the poppet spring and the interlock pin.
Fit the second poppet ball, then the 2nd/3rd shifter shaft and plate.
With one plate in neutral and the other in gear, measure the gap between the interlock sleeve end and the plate cams.
Fit the outer levers with lock washers and nuts and tighten securely.
Fit the forks to the levers, with the 1st/reverse fork hump facing down.
Installation: put a new gasket on the case, fit the cover and secure it with lock washers and cap screws.
Connect the control rod and cross shaft to the levers.

specs.what: interlock sleeve to shifter plate cam clearance

notes: Fitting the 2nd/3rd shaft is easiest when its plate passes over the ball in neutral.
Interlock sleeves come in four sizes to set the clearance.
The two rear cover-to-case bolts go through to the inside and have a special oil-sealing spline; use those bolts in those two holes.
See figure 12 in the manual for the parts.
